project.name: Bifrost Integrations
project.summary: FastAPI control plane, React SPA on Vite, and a separate execution plane for workflows and agents. PostgreSQL is the source of truth, Redis carries cache and pub/sub, S3-compatible storage holds repo files and app bundles, and Kubernetes runs isolated build jobs.

tour.note: The bulk of the domain logic and side effects, including transactional boundaries.

tour.title: Persistence
tour.note: SQLAlchemy models, Pydantic contracts and the Alembic chain; Postgres is the source of truth.

tour.note: Access checks and the workflow SDK used by API and workers alike.

tour.title: Hosted app runtime
tour.note: SDK contract, compiler and host that serve apps built inside the platform.

edges.label: hands out runs
edges.description: The API records an execution and makes it claimable; a worker leases it and runs it. Nothing long runs inside a request.

edges.label: claims, logs, results
edges.description: Workers report progress and results through the API's worker control channel.

edges.label: cache & channels
edges.description: Cached modules, sessions and WebSocket fan-out.

edges.label: files, apps, artifacts
edges.description: Workspace files, built app bundles and generated artifacts.

edges.label: isolated build pods
edges.description: Build-class jobs such as app deploys and Solution exports run in temporary pods.

edges.label: runs the build
edges.description: A deploy job calls the app compiler and bundler, then records the new deployment.

edges.label: stores built apps
edges.description: Each successful build writes its bundle to file storage for the live app to load.

edges.label: serves the live bundle
edges.description: The app host loads the active bundle through the API rather than from a build on the client.

edges.label: webhooks & pushes
edges.description: GitHub calls the API when a connected repository changes.

edges.label: OAuth & Graph
edges.description: Token exchange and Graph calls for connected Microsoft tenants.

edges.label: model calls
edges.description: Every agent and chat turn is a model request through the configured provider.

edges.label: SDK calls
edges.description: A hosted app reaches platform data only through the public API.

annotations.note: The shared CLI/SDK contract. A change here can break installed CLIs, so version gates live next to it.
The canonical durable-job system. New long-running work should extend this rather than add its own job table.
Every screen's requests pass through here, including sign-in expiry and error shaping.

flows.title: Execute a workflow
flows.description: From HTTP request to sandboxed execution and persisted result.

steps.note: executions handler: authorize, validate input, resolve workflow version
Insert the execution row and make it claimable (work dispatch)
Worker leases the claim; process pool imports the module in a child process
Workflow calls sdk.tables/files/integrations; each is an HTTP call back to the API
Result, logs and usage persisted; WebSocket fan-out to the screen

flows.title: Build and deploy an app
flows.description: App source to an active hosted deployment.

steps.note: applications handler stores source and enqueues the deploy
application.deploy PlatformJob with retries and progress
esbuild bundle against the served SDK, fingerprinted output
Deployment bundle written; the deployment row is activated atomically
Host fetches the active deployment and mounts it with the SDK

flows.title: Run an agent turn
flows.description: A chat message through the agent runtime and back.

steps.note: POST /api/chat; the client consumes the SSE stream
chat handler creates the run and returns the stream
Pydantic AI agent: instructions, toolset, budget, retry policy
Provider request with tool schemas; the model chooses tool calls
Agent run executes in the worker, persisting steps and usage
Messages, tool results and artifacts streamed to the conversation
